image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a cluster of ripe figs arranged in rows on a dark, textured surface (possibly a tray or table). The figs are predominantly deep purple/maroon with some yellowish-green highlights near the stems. They exhibit a characteristic pear-like shape, tapering from a broad base to a narrow neck where a small, pale stem is visible. The skin appears smooth but with natural variations in color and slight textural irregularities consistent with real fruit. Some figs show minor blemishes or color gradients. The lighting creates soft shadows between the fruits, enhancing their three-dimensional form. No cut figs are visible; all appear whole.
